# Generated files inventory — Experiment A (clean)

## Init command (no `--force`)

```bash
uvx --from git+https://github.com/github/spec-kit.git@v0.14.3 \
  specify init \
  /tmp/debina-spec-kit-cursor-pilot/clean-project \
  --integration cursor-agent \
  --script sh \
  --ignore-agent-tools
```

Note: empty `clean/` existed first; Spec Kit refuses init into an existing directory without `--force`, so the clean experiment used `clean-project/` (new path). No `--force` used.
